prompt: What is the name of the 2nd track on the album by Corinne Bailey Rae that came out 10 years before her album The Heart Speaks in Whispers?
answer: The album released 10 years before *The Heart Speaks in Whispers* (2016) was Corinne Bailey Rae’s self-titled debut album (2006). Its second track is **“Enchantment.”**
